subject: tu:game/game/player
value: RESOLVED: Player [0x096C, 0x0A22) is the GC image of the Xbox player struct's mikey-powerup block -- `struct atree mikey_obj_atree` (0x48) + `struct OBJGRP mikey_objgrp` (0x68) + `short mikey_dropped_flag` (research/xbox_symbols/misc.h player @0xAD0/0xB18/0xB80) -- kept at FULL Xbox size on GC, and pad_0970[0xA4] was entirely this block's interior. THE MAPPING. A constant GC->Xbox delta of +0x164 holds on both flanks of the block: anchor_pos 0x838->attn_offset 0x99C, col_radius/col_height 0x850/0x854->rad/hht 0x9B4/0x9B8, field_A1C/field_A1E/field_A20 0xA1C/0xA1E/0xA20->mikey_dropped_flag/hand_of_death_flag/health_vamp_flag 0xB80/0xB82/0xB84, pad_0A22[0xA]->__align0+num_approaching+dist_offset (exactly 10 bytes), weakening_elapsed 0xA2C->heartbeat 0xB90. Inside the block the per-member picture is fixed by GC code itself: player.c's PlayerMikeyState view struct (atree@0x96C, anim_state@0x9A4, matrix[16]@0x9B4, saved_pos[3]@0x9F4, fx_pos[3]@0xA04, node@0xA14, field_A18@0xA18, state@0xA1C) overlays Player exactly, and the atree/OBJGRP internal layouts line up byte-for-byte: atree = root@+0 (field_96C, AtreeDelete/AtreeInit take its address) + animinfo@+4 (0x38; +0x34 repeat = the view's anim_state@0x9A4) + nanodes/firstanode/anodeinfo (the 0xE tail pad 0x9A6..0x9B4); OBJGRP@0x9B4 = worldmat[4][4]@0x9B4 + attn_pos[4]@0x9F4 + coll_pos[4]@0xA04 + node@0xA14 (field_A14; the 'mikey objgrp OBJ NODE HAS KIDS' ErrorPrintf names it) + flags@0xA18 (zeroed at hatch). CONSUMER PROOF: enemy.c fn_8004CE38 reads p+0x9E4/0x9EC = mikey worldmat[3][0]/[3][2] (the mikey world translation) against the ENEMY's own objgrp.worldmat[3][0]/[3][2] for chase bearing, and fn_80046680 + gamemain.c (2 DIST3 sites) read p+0xA04..0xA0C = mikey coll_pos[0..2] against the enemy's objgrp.coll_pos -- structurally symmetric OBJGRP-vs-OBJGRP comparisons -- ALL gated on field_A1C > 2. FIELD_A1C IS THE MIKEY POWERUP STATE MACHINE, not a 'weapon-flash one-shot latch' as the header previously claimed: Xbox misc.h enum SPECIAL_MIKEY = 1048576 = 0x100000 is exactly the flags bit in player.c's `if ((p->flags & 0x100000) && p->field_A1C == 0) p->field_A1C = 1;`, PlayerFindMikeyPUP matches powerup type 9 + specialflags 0x100000, and PlayerProcessMikeyPUP runs the machine on the SAME bytes via the view: 0 = off, 1 = hatch pending, 2 = hatched (AtreeInit MIKEYPUP_ON + MBNewNode under the mikey camera parent), ++ per live tick, 300 = despawn (AtreeDelete + MBRemoveNode). So 'field_A1C > 2' in enemy.c/gamemain.c means 'this player's mikey is live -- range against the mikey object, not the player'. HEADER OUTCOME (commit e3a24cdf2): pad_0970[0xA4] split into pad_0970[0x34] (animinfo interior, no GC consumer) + mikey_anim_state s16 + pad_09A6[0xE] (atree tail) + mikey_worldmat[4][4] + mikey_attn_pos[4] + mikey_coll_pos[4], and pad_0A18[4] became s32 mikey_objgrp_flags; field_96C/field_A14/field_A1C keep their consumed identifiers (renaming would touch player.c/gamemain.c owned by other lanes) with corrected comments. All scalars/arrays-of-scalars per the embedded-cascade law; gated ALONE across 8 includer TUs (enemy/player/pmotion/critter/select/gamemain/shop/tower, all GATE OK) and a whole-project report diff (2990 functions, 0 moved). NOT claimed: the animinfo interior member names (0x970..0x9A4 kept as pad -- Xbox-only evidence, no GC consumer), and whether GC field names 'hud_flags'(0x964)/'gem_object'(0x968) should adopt their Xbox slot analogues anim_flag/hand_of_death (GC-verified semantics differ; left alone).
